Hi Dylan,

Hope youre well. Were organizing a 2-day micro-sprint (Oct 2-3) for our community of senior platform engineers and would love to offer Redwood API trial access to attendees as a practical exercise in the afternoon labs. We had great uptake last time and expect ~300 attendees to request access.

Can Redwood provide a pool of 300 trial passes (14-day trials, one per user) that we can distribute via our sign-up form? Wed ideally get the codes by next Wednesday (Sep 24) so we can embed them in our event confirmation emails.

- Single-use codes preferred (one per email)
- No automatic billing or renewal; attendees should opt-in after trial if they choose
- Were a partner running a co-branded lab page; HubSpot deal HD-987654 is open for this event

If you need a PO or anything from procurement, let me know. Appreciate any flexibility on turnaround.

Thanks,
Amit Singh
Partnerships Lead | DevOps Collective
